summary:
Nabu Casa has launched the Home Assistant Connect AUX-2, an ESP32-S3-based smart home controller that combines audio streaming, RS-232 serial control, Bluetooth LE proxy, and USB expansion for Z-Wave connectivity. It is designed for older audio systems, TVs, AV receivers, UPSs, solar inverters, and other devices to integrate into Home Assistant without cloud services. title: Home Assistant-compatible ESP32 4-channel PWM fan controller is designed for server racks and NAS systems
summary:
Designed by CoolMaker Lab in China, the ESP32 4-channel PWM fan controller is an open-source, Home Assistant-compatible board for managing cooling in server racks, NAS systems, network cabinets, and other DIY enclosures. It can independently control up to four 4-pin PWM fans, supporting PWM-based speed adjustment, tachometer-based RPM monitoring, and individual fan power switching. The controller supports up to four external DS18B20 temperature sensors for automatic fan speed adjustment, along with a web interface, an HTTP REST API, and Bluetooth proxy functionality. The latest v2.0 hardware and firmware also support optional LD2402G 24GHz mmWave radar for presence-based automation.
